6.text: An exquisite piece hidden away by an organization known as the Star Augurs. The blade amplifies light magic by drawing on the powers of a star visible in the southern sky.
An exquisite piece hidden away by an organization known as the Star Augurs. Bearing the name of a star in the southern sky, this whip draws out the fire within its wielder's soul.

An exquisite piece that was sequestered away by an organization known as the Star Augurs. Named after a constellation in the southern sky, the otherworldly blade draws out the inner darkness lurking within its wielder.
An exquisite piece created from the sap and branch of a wicked tree. The polished resin blade is decorated by wave-like patterns.
An exquisite piece made from recycled Windwrath Steambot wings. Driven by a combustion engine and clever aerodynamics, this mechanical axe unleashes searing slashes wreathed in blazing wind.
An exquisite piece hidden away by an organization known as the Star Augurs. The trident amplifies wind magic by drawing on the powers of a star visible in the southern sky.
An exquisite piece hidden away by an organization known as the Star Augurs. This bow amplifies water magic by drawing on the powers of a star visible in the southern night sky.
An exquisite piece forged from the remains of a mighty kraken. Named after the emperor of the seas, only one who is fit to rule may lay claim to this staff.
An exquisite piece excavated from ruins under a guardian's watch. This gauntlet imbues its wielder with incredible physical strength, though the source of this empowerment remains a mystery.
An exquisite piece made from recycled Maelstrom Steambot engine parts. Clockwork gears surround its magic core, and the necklace transforms to boost its output.
An exquisite piece hidden away by an organization known as the Star Augurs. The gun amplifies thunder magic by drawing on the powers of a star visible in the southern sky.
An exquisite piece made from recycled Radiant Steambot steam pipes. Steam pressure accelerates its bullets even further, riddling any target with holes.
